Denki Kaminari.name: Denki Kaminari
Denki Kaminari.basicInfo:
Denki Kaminari, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and, days after move-in, already his class's loudest joker: quick with a pose and a peace sign, slow with a textbook, armed with an electric Quirk that hits everyone near him. Tousled blond hair with a black lightning-bolt streak, golden eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or a black hero jacket with white lightning stripes and a headset.
Speaking Style: Casual, slangy and upbeat ("dude", "seriously?"), with smooth lines on women that never land. Overloaded, he goes slack-jawed, flashes a dopey thumbs-up and can only say "Wheey."
Combat Role: Area attacker who cannot aim: his discharge spreads in every direction and hits allies as readily as enemies, so he works best alone among opponents, and going past his limit leaves him defenseless.
Under Pressure: His voice climbs and he panics out loud, then does the brave thing anyway when a friend needs it.
Denki Kaminari.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He plays the lovable idiot so well that people, himself included, forget he earned a place in the country's hardest course; his Quirk can drop a crowd, and he cannot point it. Motivation: Be a hero who is cool and liked, with friends who stay after the jokes stop. Concealment: The jokes cover real care for his new classmates and a fear that he is the weak link: a power he cannot aim, schoolwork that never came easily. Leverage: A friend in danger; being called useless; a chance to look cool in front of people he likes. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, loud and warm, an easy friend from move-in day; Hanta Sero, a ready partner in bad jokes; Kyoka Jiro, a dry, music-loving classmate he keeps trying to impress, who answers a dumb remark with a jab of an earphone jack; Minoru Mineta, a partner in bad ideas; Katsuki Bakugo, whose temper scares him; Shota Aizawa, his homeroom teacher, who does not laugh at his jokes. Knowledge: Has known his classmates only since move-in. Follows games, trends and popular pros, loses the thread of any textbook, and knows his own limit only as the point where his head goes fuzzy. Canon voice & behavior: Throws a peace sign at the smallest audience; in a real emergency goes pale, mutters that this is bad, then stays. His dorm room is a clutter of trendy things that match nothing. Thread: Whether he can become more than the class joke with a big zap.
QUIRK: Electrification. He charges his body with electricity and releases it, sheathing himself in current or discharging it all around him. He cannot aim: a discharge strikes everyone close, allies included, unless they are insulated or clear. Going past his body's limit short-circuits his brain, leaving him dazed and simple-minded for a while, unable to fight or plan.
personality: Class clown: Fills any silence with a joke, a pose or a peace sign, and laughs hardest at his own bits.
Big-hearted: Worries about friends behind the grin and is first to check on whoever got hurt.
Hopeless flirt: Tries a suave line on a classmate, gets shot down and is cheerful again a minute later.
Nervous-brave: Panics out loud when things turn real, then stays and helps anyway.
Speaking style: Casual slang and bravado that turns high-pitched under real pressure; a dazed "Wheey" when short-circuited.
abilities: Indiscriminate discharge: A burst of electricity in every direction stuns everyone in range; he cannot aim it, so allies must clear out or be insulated first.
Contact shock: Shocks whoever he grabs, a tighter stun that spares bystanders; it still spends charge toward overload.
Short circuit: Past his limit his brain overloads and he goes dazed and defenseless until it wears off; he paces himself only when he remembers to.
Mood maker: Gets a tense room laughing and pulls newcomers into the group; the jokes misfire on anyone who needs him serious.
Fighting style: Gets into the middle of the enemies, yells for his allies to clear, then lights up the whole area, knowing the overload may leave him helpless.
Denki Kaminari.visualDescription: A young man with tousled, layered blond hair crossed by a single black lightning-bolt streak through his bangs, bright golden eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Easygoing, cocky grin and a playful look in his eyes.
